fixture.question: Audit the multipkg package: (1) list the modules and describe what each one does, (2) identify the main entry function and trace its callers, (3) flag any TODO comments or technical debt. Cite file paths and line numbers.

runs.label: run-1-prefix-regression
runs.final_answer_preview: Could not perform the audit because the researcher failed to execute the tool plans; no file lists, module contents, or search results were provided from the multipkg/ directory.
runs.regression_root_cause: LangGraph 1.2 Send dispatches deliver ONLY the Send dict's keys to the target node; channels not in the dict are absent from the receiver's state even with a global operator.add reducer registered. M11c-3's _fanout_after_tool_executor omitted tool_results from each per-lane Send dict, so each fanned-back researcher saw an empty tool_results channel, tool_results_for_round returned empty, and the researcher fell back to PLAN mode instead of consuming the tool results in REPORT mode. 47/49 researcher invocations stayed in PLAN mode; the two REPORT-mode entries came from a late single-researcher fallback path (lane_idx=None), producing only a partial degraded synthesis. The stubbed unit tests at the M11c-3-F closure level couldn't detect this because they invoke the routing function with a synthetic dict and inspect its return value — they never drive Pregel and never observe receiver state.
